thaumicbees.speciesSoul.description: "The Dread Pirate Roberts has come for your SOOOOOOULS!"|Dread Pirate Roberts
thaumicbees.speciesArcane.description: "Their produce is charged with magic."|Azanor, Master Thaumaturge
thaumicbees.speciesIron.description: Having absorbed some of the base metal, these bees can concentrate the essence of iron from the region.|Apinomicon
thaumicbees.speciesChicken.description: "Cluck. Cluck cluck! ... You heard me."|Confused bee
thaumicbees.speciesEmerald.description: It is said they have been to a land ruled by a Great Wizard, and have taken the aspect of his city.|Apinomicon
thaumicbees.speciesBrainy.description: Their combs may be fetid and foul-smelling, but their intelligence is well-developed.|Apinomicon
thaumicbees.speciesTimely.description: "An apiarist is never late. He arrives precisely when he means to!"|Sengir, Mad Apiarist
thaumicbees.speciesAura.description: "They work so fast it's breathtaking."|Sengir, Mad Apiarist
thaumicbees.speciesTin.description: While metalic, these bees are suprisingly fragile.|Apinomicon
thaumicbees.speciesAqua.description: "I tried to breed them once, but that was a wash."|MysteriousAges, Apprentice Thaumaturge
thaumicbees.speciesWispy.description: Their language is garbled and unintelligible. It is probable they are speaking to unnatural beings.|Apinomicon
thaumicbees.speciesBatty.description: They tend to attract bats to their hives through means unknown.|Apinomicon
thaumicbees.speciesSupernatural.descript: These bees walk the line between this world and the unseen.|Apinomicon
thaumicbees.speciesSpirit.description: It is said these bees are able to contact the dead.|Apinomicon
thaumicbees.speciesVis.description: "They can feel changes in the aura, but are not yet able to affect it."|Azanor, research notes

thaumicbees.speciesSkulking.description: These bees have become xenophobic and bad-tempered. Use caution.|Apinomicon
thaumicbees.speciesCopper.description: A base metal common in many applications; these bees are helpful for resource-starved magicians.|Apinomicon
thaumicbees.speciesSavant.description: lim(x^(i / pi)/ log(e * 7 - ln(32/x^-pi))). Solve for honey.|Note found on Yorae's desk
thaumicbees.speciesAware.description: "They can see into your soul!"|Florastar, Expert Beekeeper
thaumicbees.speciesStark.description: "These are unusually attracted to shards. This warrents further investigation."|Azanor, Master Thaumaturge
thaumicbees.speciesIgnis.description: Caution: Contents of hive extremely hot.|Warning label on Azanor's apiary
thaumicbees.speciesLead.description: A favourite of amateur alchemists, they believe they can transform these bees into gold.|Apinomicon
thaumicbees.speciesMinium.description: "They're the least of your concern. Like, the Minium concern! ... get it?"|MysteriousAges, Former Comedian
thaumicbees.speciesCharmed.description: Your first experiments in Thaumaturgical Apiculture have yielded fruit. Buzzing fruit.|Apinomicon
thaumicbees.speciesSolum.description: "You're really gonna dig these bees, but watch out - they bore quite easily."|MysteriousAges, Apprentice Comedian
thaumicbees.speciesLordly.description: They live in peace, within the sight of the Eye of Harmony|Tattered Remains of ancient Apinomicon
thaumicbees.speciesNode.description: Having undergone a freak mutation, these bees now attract magic to them.|Apinomicon
thaumicbees.speciesGossamer.description: As they work, they seem to fade out from light for brief moments.|Apinomicon
thaumicbees.speciesGold.description: Not all that glitters is gold.|Ancient Aphorism
